payload.name: Support Ticket Validator
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Support Ticket Validator checks whether support ticket data contains the required fields before human processing or handoff. It returns a structured completeness result with checked fields, present fields, missing fields, and validation errors, helping support teams identify incomplete ticket information without modifying external systems.
payload.longDescription: Support Ticket Validator 会在人工作业或交接前，检查支持工单数据是否包含所需的必填字段。它返回结构化的完整性检查结果，包括已检查字段、已提供字段、缺失字段及验证错误，帮助支持团队识别不完整的工单信息，同时不修改外部系统。

payload.name: Giraffe
payload.description: 让 AI 项目保持清晰
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Giraffe keeps your AI projects clear and current across ChatGPT and other compatible AI assistants. Save and retrieve project context, decisions, facts, notes, open questions, and documents from whichever AI tool you are using.

When plans change, Giraffe helps preserve the latest agreed state, what changed, and which earlier information was replaced—so you can continue working without searching through old chats or rebuilding context.

Use Giraffe to organize Spaces and Projects, search your knowledge, and create or update Documents directly from your AI assistant. Giraffe is free to use.
payload.longDescription:
Giraffe 可在 ChatGPT 及其他兼容的 AI 助手中，帮助你保持 AI 项目清晰且信息最新。无论你使用哪种 AI 工具，都可以保存和检索项目上下文、决策、事实、笔记、待解决问题和文档。

计划发生变化时，Giraffe 会帮助保留最新达成的一致状态、记录变更内容以及标记被替代的旧信息，让你无需翻找旧聊天或重建上下文即可继续工作。

通过 AI 助手使用 Giraffe 整理 Spaces 和 Projects、搜索知识，并直接创建或更新文档。Giraffe 可免费使用。

payload.name: Jamie
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bring your meetings into ChatGPT. Ask about your work, draw on conversation context, and get work done.
payload.longDescription: 将你的会议带入 ChatGPT。询问工作相关问题，利用对话上下文，高效完成工作。

payload.name: Signeasy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Signeasy helps users review account activity, find documents and contracts, inspect signature status, send reminders, and prepare or send signature requests through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Signeasy 可帮助用户查看账户活动、查找文档和合同、查看签署状态、发送提醒，并通过 ChatGPT 准备或发送签署请求。

payload.name: Word Counter
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Accurate word and character counts for drafts, essays, and snippets — using the same rules as ibm.io/wordcount. Returns words, characters, sentences, paragraphs, and reading time. Includes an in-chat widget for quick visual summary. Text is processed in memory and not stored. For private editing with word goals, link to the full offline browser app.
payload.longDescription: 按照与 ibm.io/wordcount 相同的规则，准确统计草稿、文章和片段的字数与字符数。可返回单词、字符、句子、段落和阅读时间，并提供聊天内小组件，快速直观地查看摘要。文本仅在内存中处理，不会保存。如需带字数目标的私密编辑，可链接到完整的离线浏览器应用。

payload.name: Tenzo AI MCP
payload.description: 询问有关 Tenzo 数据的问题
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ask your recruiting data anything. The Tenzo AI MCP server connects your AI assistant to your hiring pipeline, so instead of clicking through screens you can just ask: who applied for this role, where each candidate stands, how they did on their AI screening call, and what's changed this week.

Pull up a candidate and follow them end to end - their applications and stages, resume, SMS and email history, and the full screening-call transcript, grade, and summary. Check how a job is configured, review meeting notes, and surface hiring analytics, all in plain language.

Access is read-only and OAuth-authenticated, so the assistant can read your data but never change it, and everything stays scoped to your organization.
payload.longDescription:
关于招聘数据，想问什么都可以。Tenzo AI MCP 服务器会将 AI 助手连接到招聘流程，因此你无需逐页点击，只需询问：谁申请了这个职位、每位候选人目前处于哪个阶段、他们在 AI 筛选面试中的表现如何，以及本周发生了哪些变化。

打开候选人资料并查看完整流程，包括其申请和阶段、简历、SMS 和电子邮件往来记录，以及完整的筛选面试文字稿、评分和摘要。查看职位配置、审阅会议记录，并用自然语言获取招聘分析。

访问采用只读模式并通过 OAuth 验证，因此助手可以读取你的数据，但无法更改数据；所有内容都限定在你的组织范围内。

payload.name: Jaggle
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect ChatGPT to Jaggle to search, review, organize, and safely update permission-filtered workspace work.
payload.longDescription: 将 ChatGPT 连接到 Jaggle，以搜索、审阅、整理并安全更新经过权限筛选的工作区内容。

payload.name: Cal.com
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Cal.com helps users browse personal and team event types, find timezone-aware availability, and list, create, reschedule, or cancel ordinary bookings through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Cal.com 帮助用户浏览个人和团队活动类型、查找考虑时区的可预约时段，并通过 ChatGPT 查看、创建、改期或取消普通预约。

payload.name: anew
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: anew encodes self-contained HTML documents, fragments, or plain text into publicly resolvable URLs that carry the page itself. No account or information is required.
payload.longDescription: anew将自包含的HTML文档、片段或纯文本编码为可公开解析的URL，这些URL直接承载页面内容。无需账户或信息。

payload.name: HWPXkit
payload.description: 填写和编辑 HWPX 文档
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: HWPXkit opens an HWPX file from a link or attachment, lists editable cells, paragraphs, LaTeX equations, and rows, then fills form blanks or applies text, run-formatting, and row edits. It returns a downloadable edited copy and supports a one-step rollback; the source file is never changed.
payload.longDescription: HWPXkit 可从链接或附件打开 HWPX 文件，列出可编辑的单元格、段落、LaTeX 公式和行，然后填写表单空白处，或应用文本、文本片段格式和行编辑。它会返回可下载的编辑副本，并支持一步撤销；源文件不会被更改。

payload.name: Supermemory
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Supermemory builds your personal or company context and makes it interoperable between all providers. Use it to create a shared company brain that you can use with any AI agent with a team, or for personal use.
payload.longDescription: Supermemory可为你构建个人或企业上下文，并实现跨所有提供者的互操作性。可用于打造共享的公司大脑，可与任何AI代理配合使用，适用于团队或个人场景。

payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
PostFast is a social media management tool. This plugin connects your existing PostFast workspace so you can run your posting workflow in conversation instead of opening the dashboard.

Plan and schedule
Draft a post, choose which of your connected accounts it goes to, attach an image or video, and place it on the calendar for a specific time. Save it as a draft, route it for approval, or approve one that is already waiting. Review what is queued and remove a scheduled post. Supported accounts: X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Pinterest, Threads, YouTube, Bluesky, Telegram, and Google Business Profile.

Check how posts did
Look up the performance of a published post, or how an account's follower count has moved day by day. Analytics cover Instagram, Facebook, Threads, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest Business accounts, and LinkedIn company pages.

Add an account
Generate a link that opens PostFast's account connection flow when you want to add a new social profile.

How it works
PostFast connects to each social network under its own app registrations and platform credentials, and stores your drafts, scheduled posts, media and comment history in your own PostFast workspace. This plugin is a first-party interface to that product, not a generic pass-through layer. Some tools do call a platform live, for example when publishing a post, and each of those is labelled as such.

You sign in with your existing PostFast account over OAuth. Viewing accounts, writing posts, and reading analytics are separate permissions that you grant individually, and you can disconnect at any time. The connector also exposes comment management tools used by other clients, which are not part of the workflows described here.

查找 My AskAI 产品、设置、集成、API、功能、定价和故障排除信息。
搜索公共知识库，阅读完整文档和 OpenAPI 文件，并根据月度支持工单数量估算定价。

payload.name: Czy Jest Eldorado?
payload.description: 搜索 IT 职位信息
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
CzyJestEldorado is a job search engine focused exclusively on the Polish IT market. This connector gives AI agents direct access to our job listings database, updated in real time. We index the largest IT job portals in Poland, and additionally monitor employer ATS systems, company websites, and government organizations — so the database also includes listings unavailable anywhere else.

Offers can be filtered by work mode (remote, hybrid, onsite), contract type, salary range, technology stack, seniority level, location, and publication date, with support for excluding specific keywords or companies.
payload.longDescription:
CzyJestEldorado 是专注波兰 IT 市场的职位搜索引擎。此连接器让 AI 代理直接访问实时更新的职位数据库。我们收录波兰最大的 IT 招聘门户，并额外监测雇主 ATS 系统、公司网站和政府机构，因此数据库还包含其他地方找不到的职位。

职位可按工作模式（远程、混合、现场）、合同类型、薪资范围、技术栈、资历、地点和发布日期筛选，并支持排除特定关键词或公司。

payload.name: AI Detector by AI GPT Zero
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Check essays, research papers, articles, and professional documents for signs of AI-generated writing inside ChatGPT. This AI detector and AI checker analyzes text you provide and returns AI and human likelihood scores, sentence-level highlights, and review guidance. The interactive workspace keeps your original text and detection results together for a clear, focused review.

Use it as a ChatGPT detector when reviewing text that may contain AI-generated writing, an AI essay checker for academic manuscripts, or an AI content detector for editorial and business documents. The tool supports AI writing review by bringing overall scores and individual sentence highlights into the same view, helping you identify passages that deserve closer attention.

Paste text into the workspace, run an AI detection scan, and read the overall assessment. Inspect highlighted sentences, consider the review guidance, and compare the results with the surrounding paragraphs. This text-checking workflow helps you move from a general question about possible AI use to a closer examination of specific passages.

Educators and researchers can use the AI text detector to support the review of essays, assignments, research papers, literature reviews, and other academic writing. Consider the findings alongside drafts, citations, source material, assignment requirements, and discussion with the author. Sentence-level AI detection provides an additional reference for understanding the text within its academic context.

Editors, publishers, journalists, and content teams can examine contributed articles, blog posts, newsletters, opinion pieces, and editorial drafts for possible AI-generated content. Use the AI content checker during an editorial review to identify sections that warrant follow-up with the writer and to keep the discussion grounded in the supplied text.

Marketing and SEO teams can review website copy, landing-page text, product descriptions, campaign content, and client deliverables. Business teams can check reports, proposals, and other professional writing. The same AI writing detector workflow helps reviewers examine the text they receive and decide where additional context or author input would be useful.

Whether you need an AI text checker for a research manuscript, a GPT detector for an article, or AI-generated text detection for business content, the workspace combines an overall assessment with sentence-level detail. Review possible AI writing, inspect the highlighted passages, and use the results to guide a more informed conversation about the content.

Detection results are estimates and should be interpreted with context and human judgment.
payload.longDescription:
在 ChatGPT 中检查论文、研究报告、文章和专业文档是否存在AI生成写作的迹象。这款AI检测工具会分析你提供的文本，返回AI及人类写作的可能性评分、句子级高亮和审阅建议。交互式工作区将原文和检测结果放在一起，便于清晰、专注地审阅。

审阅可能含有AI生成内容的文本时，可将其用作 ChatGPT 检测工具；检查学术文稿时，可用作AI论文检测工具；检查编辑及商业文档时，可用作AI内容检测工具。它将总体评分和各句高亮汇集在同一视图中，支持AI写作审阅，帮助你识别需要进一步关注的段落。

将文本粘贴到工作区，运行AI检测扫描，并阅读总体评估。检查高亮句子、考虑审阅建议，并结合周围段落比较结果。这一文本检查流程帮助你从是否可能使用AI的一般性问题，深入到具体段落的细致检查。

教育工作者和研究人员可使用AI文本检测工具辅助审阅论文、作业、研究报告、文献综述和其他学术写作。应结合草稿、引用、源材料、作业要求及与作者的沟通来考虑检测结果。句子级AI检测为在学术语境中理解文本提供额外参考。

编辑、出版商、记者和内容团队可检查投稿文章、博客文章、新闻简报、评论文章和编辑稿件中是否可能含有AI生成内容。在编辑审阅中使用AI内容检测工具，识别需要向作者进一步核实的部分，并让讨论以所提供的文本为依据。

营销和SEO团队可审阅网站文案、落地页文本、产品描述、营销活动内容和客户交付成果。业务团队可检查报告、提案和其他专业写作。同样的AI写作检测流程帮助审阅人员检查收到的文本，判断哪些地方需要更多背景信息或作者说明。

无论你需要研究文稿的AI文本检测、文章的GPT检测，还是商业内容的AI生成文本检测，工作区都将总体评估与句子级细节结合起来。审阅可能由AI撰写的内容、检查高亮段落，并利用结果引导更有依据的内容讨论。

检测结果属于估计，应结合上下文和人的判断进行解读。

payload.name: Page2AI
payload.description: 将公开网页转换为 Markdown
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Page2AI converts a single public web page — only the URL you explicitly provide — into clean Markdown for LLM context: main content extracted, boilerplate dropped, headings, code blocks, tables and links preserved, optional YAML frontmatter with the source URL and title. On-demand and read-only: no crawling, no accounts, no data stored by the application. It does not bypass paywalls, logins, rate limits or any site's access controls; private-network and cloud-metadata URLs are refused; responses are capped at 10 MB with enforced timeouts and per-IP rate limits. The identical MIT-licensed engine is available as a local MCP server (npx -y page2ai-mcp) for fully private workflows.
payload.longDescription: Page2AI 会将单个公开网页（仅限你明确提供的 URL）转换为适合大型语言模型上下文的整洁 Markdown：提取主要内容并去除模板杂项，同时保留标题、代码块、表格和链接；还可选择添加包含来源 URL 和标题的 YAML 前置元数据。按需运行且只读：不会爬取网页、不需要账户，也不会由应用存储数据。它不会绕过付费墙、登录、速率限制或任何网站的访问控制；会拒绝私有网络和云元数据 URL；响应上限为 10 MB，并强制实施超时和按 IP 限速。相同的 MIT 许可引擎也可作为本地 MCP 服务器使用（npx -y page2ai-mcp），适用于完全私密的工作流。

payload.name: Deep Document Search
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Deep Document Search turns ChatGPT into a powerful interface for your private document knowledge base. Search and analyze PDFs, Word files, scanned documents, and large document collections using natural language; find relevant information across thousands or millions of files; and get accurate, traceable answers with citations back to the original documents. It is built for document-intensive workflows such as legal research, regulatory compliance, corporate knowledge, due diligence, research, and document analysis.
payload.longDescription: Deep Document Search 将 ChatGPT 转变为私有文档知识库的强大界面。使用自然语言搜索和分析 PDF、Word 文件、扫描文档及大型文档集合；从数千或数百万份文件中查找相关信息；并获取准确、可追溯且引用原始文档的答案。适用于法律研究、法规合规、企业知识管理、尽职调查、研究和文档分析等文档密集型工作流。

payload.name: gradireland
payload.description: 在爱尔兰寻找毕业生职位
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find your graduate jobs, internships or placements across Ireland, directly in ChatGPT. Search by role, location or sector, check requirements and deadlines, and explore opportunities from leading employers. When you’re ready, open the full listing on gradireland to apply. Plus, discover career events, tools and advice built for students and recent graduates.
payload.longDescription: 直接在 ChatGPT 中查找爱尔兰各地的毕业生职位、实习或实习安排。按职位、地点或行业搜索，查看要求和截止日期，并探索知名雇主提供的机会。准备好申请时，可在 gradireland 上打开完整职位信息并提交申请。此外还可发现面向学生和应届毕业生的职业活动、工具和建议。

payload.name: Coverlttr
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Coverlttr helps users create job-targeted cover letters from their uploaded CV and a job description. Through ChatGPT, users can check their credit balance, browse saved job listings, estimate generation cost, create or regenerate a letter, apply a professional LaTeX template (PDF), and export the final document — all without leaving the conversation.
payload.longDescription: Coverlttr 根据用户上传的简历和职位描述，帮助创建针对具体职位的求职信。通过 ChatGPT，用户可以查看积分余额、浏览已保存的职位信息、估算生成费用、创建或重新生成求职信、应用专业 LaTeX 模板（PDF），并导出最终文档——全程无需离开对话。

payload.name: SEO&OH AI
payload.description: 查找录音的转写、摘要和思维导图
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: 서앤오AI 녹음 앱에 저장된 녹음을 ChatGPT에서 바로 찾아보세요. 녹음 목록과 상세 정보, 전체 전사본, AI 요약, 마인드맵을 불러올 수 있습니다. 로그인한 본인 계정의 데이터만 읽어오며, 어떤 데이터도 수정하거나 삭제하지 않는 읽기 전용 도구입니다. 회의·인터뷰·강의 녹음을 검색하고 핵심만 빠르게 확인하는 데 유용합니다.
payload.longDescription: 在 ChatGPT 中直接查找保存在 서앤오AI 录音应用里的录音。你可以调取录音列表和详情、完整转写文本、AI 摘要及思维导图。它只读取已登录账户本人的数据，不会修改或删除任何数据，是一款只读工具。适合搜索会议、访谈和课程录音，并快速了解重点。

payload.name: Proposal.Biz
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create professional, beautifully designed business documents from a single prompt in under 60 seconds. Just describe what you need and let AI do the rest.
payload.longDescription: 在60秒内通过单个提示生成专业且精美设计的商业文档。只需描述您的需求，其余交给AI完成。

payload.name: Mintlify
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect Mintlify to Claude to keep your documentation accurate and up to date without leaving your conversations. payload.name: Graffiticode

payload.name: Redpine
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Web search returns abstracts, paywalls, and citations that cannot be checked. Redpine returns the relevant chunk of the document.

Redpine licenses full-text research directly from publishers and research institutions, and serves it to ChatGPT/Codex over MCP alongside a large open-access corpus. One query searches both.

Provenance by default. Every result carries its publisher, title, publication date, and a resolvable identifier such as a DOI. Licensed content and open-access content are labeled separately, so the two are never confused inside an answer.

You see the price first. Any search can be previewed for free. ChatGPT/Codex sees the title, source, and a snippet of every result, plus the exact cost to unlock them, then asks before spending anything. Unlock the three results that matter instead of the 30 that came back. The same results re-fetch free for seven days. Discovery, schema inspection, previews, and balance checks are always free.

Built for questions where being wrong is expensive. Clinical decisions, systematic review, research engineering, and any analysis that has to survive a source check.

An account can also hold data integrations beyond literature. ChatGPT/Codex reads what that account is entitled to at runtime rather than assuming a fixed tool list.

Compensation flows back to the rights holders. New accounts get free queries. Credits are bought on the Redpine dashboard, and the connector never handles payment details: it shows the price and asks before anything is charged.

Requires a Redpine account. Sign-in is OAuth on first use.
payload.longDescription:
网页搜索返回的摘要、付费墙和无法验证的引用。Redpine 返回文档的相关片段。

Redpine 直接从出版商和研究机构授权全文研究，并通过 MCP 与大量开放获取语料库一起提供给 ChatGPT/Codex。一个查询可同时搜索两者。

默认显示来源信息。每个结果都包含其出版商、标题、出版日期和可解析的标识符，如 DOI。授权内容和开放获取内容会单独标注，确保答案中不会混淆两者。

您会先看到价格。任何搜索均可免费预览。ChatGPT/Codex 会显示每个结果的标题、来源和摘要，以及解锁它们的确切成本，然后在花费任何费用之前询问您。可选择解锁最重要的三个结果而非返回的30个结果。相同结果七天内可免费重新获取。发现、模式检查、预览和余额查询始终免费。

专为错误代价高昂的场景设计。临床决策、系统综述、研究工程以及任何需要通过来源核查的分析场景。

账户还可集成超越文献的数据。ChatGPT/Codex 在运行时读取该账户有权访问的内容，而不是假设固定的工具列表。

补偿会返还给权利持有者。新账户可获得免费查询次数。积分在 Redpine 仪表板上购买，连接器从不处理支付详情：仅显示价格并在任何费用产生前询问。

需要Redpine账户

payload.name: GovQuery
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
GovQuery is a powerful search engine that makes U.S. government reports and data easier to explore, locate, and understand.
 
Built by the Program Integrity Alliance, GovQuery processes over 300,000 articles, reports, and oversight recommendations to make them more digestible for AI platforms — offering deeper, more targeted search than general-purpose engines. Every result links to the exact page where content appears, and you can filter by granular categories unavailable on the source platforms.
 
Data sources currently include:
 
- Reports from the Government Accountability Office (GAO), federal inspectors general (Oversight.gov), and the Congressional Research Service (CRS)
- Department of Justice press releases
- Executive orders (last six presidents)

GovQuery also includes all open oversight recommendations from the GAO and federal inspectors general (Oversight.gov), with tools to analyze them by category and track trends over time.
 
New data sources are added regularly.
 
You can register for a free account at: https://www.programintegrity.org (click on the person icon top-right)

For more information on GovQuery data, please see our FAQ (https://www.programintegrity.org/faq).
payload.longDescription:
GovQuery 是一款强大的搜索引擎，让美国政府报告和数据更容易探索、查找和理解。

GovQuery 由 Program Integrity Alliance 构建，处理超过 300,000 篇文章、报告和监督建议，使其更便于 AI 平台理解；相比通用搜索引擎，它提供更深入、更有针对性的搜索。每条结果都链接到内容所在的确切页面，你还可以使用源平台不提供的细分分类进行筛选。

目前的数据来源包括：

- Government Accountability Office（GAO）、联邦监察长（Oversight.gov）和 Congressional Research Service（CRS）的报告

GovQuery 还收录 GAO 和联邦监察长（Oversight.gov）所有尚未结案的监督建议，并提供按类别分析和追踪趋势的工具。

payload.name: REPSLog

payload.name: Auto Photos
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Auto is a smart camera app. Connect to Auto to use  photos from the Auto iOS App in ChatGPT. 

Search by content, location, time. Auto understands what is in your photos, your ChatGPT and Agents use them.
payload.longDescription:
Auto是一款智能相机应用。
连接到Auto，即可在ChatGPT中使用来自Auto iOS应用的照片。

通过内容、位置、时间进行搜索。
Auto能识别照片中的内容，您的ChatGPT和代理将使用这些照片。

payload.name: Pantry Persona
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Your kitchen inside ChatGPT: recipes, a weekly meal plan, and a grocery list built from what's already at home.

Pantry Persona remembers what's in your fridge, what your family can and can't eat, and which brands you prefer, then keeps everything in sync as you cook and shop through the week.

Meal plans: Generate a full week of meals in one ask, or build it day by day. Plans respect your household's food preferences and eating rules automatically and carry per-meal nutrition.

Recipes: Save a recipe from a website, a cooking video, or a social post, or create one in conversation. Search by ingredient, cuisine, or what you can make right now with what's on hand, and group favorites into collections.

Shopping lists: Visual, interactive lists organized by store. Ask for one from your meal plan and it skips anything already in your pantry; check items off with one tap and send it to Instacart when you're ready to buy.

Cook Mode: Start cooking a recipe and get step-by-step guidance. When you're done, ingredients are deducted from your pantry and leftovers are tracked with expiration dates.

Household: Profiles store each family member's food preferences, eating rules, favorite brands, and nutrition targets, and every suggestion, plan, and search filters through them. Invite family members and everyone works from the same pantry, recipes, and shopping lists in real time.

Nutrition: See calories and macros on every recipe and meal, set daily targets for each person, and check how today or the week is stacking up. Log what you actually ate, even a meal out, and it counts toward your totals.

Receipts and staples: Pantry Persona tracks expiration dates, predicts when you'll run low on staples, and learns the brands and prices you buy. Grocery receipts become an up-to-date inventory and a clear picture of your spending.

A guided setup gets a new kitchen planned and shopped in a few questions.
payload.longDescription:
你的厨房入驻ChatGPT：食谱、每周膳食计划以及基于家中现有食材生成的购物清单。

Pantry Persona会记住冰箱里的食材、家人可食用与禁忌的食品，以及偏好的品牌，随后在你整周烹饪和购物过程中始终保持同步。

膳食计划：通过一次操作生成整周膳食，或逐日逐步构建。计划会自动遵循家庭的饮食偏好和规则，并包含每餐的营养信息。

食谱：可保存网站、烹饪视频或社交帖子中的食谱，或通过对话创建食谱。可根据食材、菜系或当前手头食材可制作的菜品进行搜索，并将收藏的食谱分组整理。

购物清单：按商店分类的可视化互动清单。从膳食计划生成清单时会自动跳过已存在于储物柜的物品；点击即可勾选商品，准备购买时可直接发送至Instacart。

烹饪模式：开始烹饪食谱后可获得分步指导。完成烹饪后，食材会从储物柜中扣除，剩余食材会记录保质期。

家庭成员：资料档案存储每位家庭成员的饮食偏好、饮食规则、喜爱品牌和营养目标，所有建议、计划和搜索都会通过这些信息进行筛选。可邀请家庭成员加入，所有人可实时共享同一份储物柜、食谱和购物清单。

营养数据：在每道食谱和每餐中查看卡路里和宏量营养素，为每位家庭成员设定每日目标，并查看当天或当周的累计情况。记录你实际摄入的食物，即使是在外就餐，都会计入总摄入量。

收据与日常用品：Pantry Persona会追踪保质期，预测日常用品即将用尽的时间，并学习你常购买的品牌和价格。购物收据将转化为实时库存，清晰呈现你的消费情况。

引导式设置功能可通过几个问题，快速完成新厨房的规划与采购。

payload.name: Dillr
payload.description: 保存食谱、规划餐食并烹饪
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ask ChatGPT for a recipe, then actually cook it: Dillr turns it into a step-by-step cook mode with built-in timers and the ingredients one tap away. 

When you find a keeper, save it. Dillr remembers your recipes and your preferences, so every suggestion is relevant to you.

Plan your week in one conversation: real recipes for every meal and a shopping list organized the way you shop, ready to tick off when you're at the store.

Everything you save lives in Dillr, accessible by ChatGPT and in the app when you want it.
payload.longDescription:
向 ChatGPT 索要食谱，然后真正动手烹饪：Dillr 会将食谱转换为逐步烹饪模式，内置计时器，食材信息只需轻点即可查看。

找到喜欢的食谱后就保存下来。Dillr 会记住你的食谱和偏好，因此每条建议都与你相关。

在一段对话中规划一周：为每餐安排真实食谱，并生成按你的购物习惯整理好的购物清单，到店后可逐项勾选。

所有保存内容都存放在 Dillr 中，可由 ChatGPT 访问，也可在你需要时通过应用查看。

payload.name: GramPrompt
payload.description: 通过聊天创建、销售与购物
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ScanGym lets you find and book gym day passes at thousands of gyms - no membership required. Search gyms by city or your location, compare day-pass prices, opening hours and reviews, then book a session as a guest with just your email. You pay securely on scangym.com and receive a QR code for gym entry. Free cancellation up to 2 hours before your session, with automatic refunds. Perfect for travellers, commuters, and anyone who wants to train without being tied to one gym.
payload.longDescription:
ScanGym让你可以扫描并找到数千家健身房的日卡预约方式——无需会员资格。
通过城市或位置搜索健身房，比较日卡价格、营业时间和评价，仅需邮箱即可作为访客预订课程。
您将在scangym.com安全支付，并获得用于健身房入场的二维码。
在课程开始前2小时可免费取消，支持自动退款。
适合旅行者、通勤人士以及希望不受单一健身房束缚的人群。

payload.name: Fluent
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Fluent works inside ChatGPT, bringing in what matters for each question. A clothing purchase can draw on your closet and clothing budget. A meal plan can draw on your tastes, grocery needs, and grocery spending. Each question uses the combination that makes sense for it. You choose what to save, and Fluent returns the saved result so ChatGPT can confirm what changed. You can inspect, correct, export, or delete the information you add.
payload.longDescription: Fluent在ChatGPT内部运行，为每个问题整合相关的信息。购买衣物时可参考你的衣橱和衣物预算，制定饮食计划时可参考你的口味、杂货需求和杂货支出。每个问题都会使用最适合的组合方案。你可以选择保存哪些内容，Fluent会返回保存的结果，让ChatGPT确认发生了哪些变化。你可以查看、更正、导出或删除所添加的信息。

payload.name: ShotPulled
payload.description: 追踪并调校意式浓缩咖啡
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Dial in better espresso, one informed adjustment at a time.
Set up your beans, grinder, espresso machine, and scale once. After each shot, log the dose, yield, brew time, and how it tasted. ShotPulled considers the full context—including the coffee’s age and the way your grinder is calibrated—then recommends the single most useful adjustment for your next shot and explains why.
ShotPulled also keeps your coffee inventory accurate automatically. Every logged dose is deducted from the bag, so you can see the grams remaining and an estimate of how many shots are left based on the dose you actually use. It tracks the bag’s peak window too, showing how many peak days remain and the date that window ends.
When a recipe works, lock it in and return to it anytime. ShotPulled supports grinder settings across clicks, numbered collars, compound ring positions such as 1.2.2, and named settings, with built-in specifications for 67 grinders, 124 espresso machines, and 24 scales.
Your ShotPulled account stays in sync across ChatGPT, the web dashboard, and the iPhone app. Register a bag here, and it’s already waiting on your phone when you’re ready to pull your next shot.
payload.longDescription:
一步一步调校出更好的意式浓缩咖啡。
一次性设置好咖啡豆、磨豆机、意式咖啡机和秤。每次萃取后，记录粉量、液重、萃取时间和口感。ShotPulled 会综合考虑全部情况（包括咖啡豆的新鲜度和磨豆机的校准方式），然后推荐下一杯最值得尝试的一项调整并说明原因。
ShotPulled 还会自动准确记录咖啡库存。每次记录的用粉量都会从咖啡豆袋库存中扣除，因此你可以查看剩余克数，并根据实际用粉量估算还能萃取几杯。它还会追踪咖啡豆的风味巅峰期，显示剩余巅峰天数和该时段结束日期。
配方成功后，可以将其锁定并随时调用。ShotPulled 支持以刻度、编号调节环、复合环位（例如 1.2.2）和命名档位记录磨豆机设置，并内置 67 款磨豆机、124 款意式咖啡机和 24 款秤的规格。
你的 ShotPulled 账户会在 ChatGPT、网页版控制面板和 iPhone 应用之间同步。在这里登记一袋咖啡豆，等你准备好萃取下一杯时，它就已经在手机上等你了。

payload.name: Newsmind — RSS for your AI
payload.description: 阅读和搜索你的 RSS 订阅
payload.summaryOriginal: Read and search your RSS feeds
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Newsmind connects your RSS subscriptions to ChatGPT. Ask what's new and get briefings from the sources you chose; search your feeds by keyword or by meaning; group the same story across outlets; star and organize articles; and set watches on topics so matches are waiting next time you ask. Read position syncs across conversations, and existing subscriptions import in one step via OPML.
payload.longDescription: Newsmind 将你的 RSS 订阅连接到 ChatGPT。询问最新动态，获取你选择来源的简报；按关键词或含义搜索订阅内容；汇总不同媒体对同一新闻的报道；为文章加星标并整理归类；还可以关注主题，让匹配内容在你下次提问时随时可查。阅读进度会在不同对话间同步；现有订阅可通过 OPML 一次性导入。

payload.name: HOUSE ’N’ STARS
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
HOUSE ’N’ STARS is a read-only AI-native luxury real estate dataset connector for ChatGPT.

It allows users to search and retrieve real public luxury property listings from the HOUSE ’N’ STARS structured dataset, including Monaco, the French Riviera, Dubai, Abu Dhabi and selected international luxury destinations.

The app helps ChatGPT access public property data such as title, location, property type, Sale/Rent status, price display, bedrooms, bathrooms, surface, features and public listing URL.

Listings are supplied by professional real estate agencies admitted to the HOUSE ’N’ STARS platform. The platform applies a curation and quality-control layer to support reliable discovery, structured presentation and a consistent user experience.

The connector is strictly read-only and public-data-only. It does not create, edit, delete, reserve, buy, sell or publish properties. It does not request or process sensitive personal data, payment details, identity documents, financial documents or precise user location. It also does not provide legal, financial, valuation or investment advice.
payload.longDescription:
HOUSE ’N’ STARS 是面向 ChatGPT
的只读、AI 原生奢华房地产数据连接器。用户可搜

索并获取来自结构化数据集的真实公开豪宅列表，覆盖摩纳哥、法国里维埃拉、迪拜、阿布扎比及精选国际目的地。可访

问标题、位置、房产类型、出售/出租状态、价格、卧室、浴室、面积、特色和公开列表网址。列表由平台接纳的专业房

地产机构提供，并经过策展和质量控制。连接器严格只读、仅使用公开数据，不创建、编辑、删除、预订、买卖或发布房

产，也不索取或处理敏感个人资料、支付信息、身份证件、财务文件或精确位置，不提供法律、财务、估值或投资建议。该功能为只读。

payload.name: Adagio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use your Adagio account to inspect, create, validate, and safely update scientific pipelines with exact action specifications and compatibility checks. Pipeline execution and local file access remain in Adagio Desktop.
payload.longDescription: 使用 Adagio 账户，通过精确的操作规范和兼容性检查，查看、创建、验证和安全更新科研管道。管道执行和本地文件访问仍在 Adagio Desktop 中进行。

payload.name: Photo Metadata Remover
payload.description: 移除 EXIF、GPS 和元数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Remove EXIF and GPS metadata from photos before sharing. Photo Metadata Remover opens a private cleaner inside ChatGPT for JPEG, PNG, and WebP images. Inspect hidden location, camera, date, XMP, IPTC, and related fields, then download a separate cleaned copy. Processing stays in the widget; KamnevApps does not receive the selected photo or cleaned output.
payload.longDescription: 分享照片前，移除其中的 EXIF 和 GPS 元数据。Photo Metadata Remover 会在 ChatGPT 中打开一个私密清理工具，支持 JPEG、PNG 和 WebP 图片。您可以检查隐藏的位置、相机、日期、XMP、IPTC 及相关字段，然后下载单独的清理后副本。处理过程在小组件内完成；KamnevApps 不会收到您选择的照片或清理后的文件。

payload.name: Capsule CRM
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Chat with your Capsule CRM directly in ChatGPT and Codex. Ask who you should follow up with, find contacts, review your pipeline, prep for meetings, or get quick reports on what matters most - in plain, everyday language.

You can also ask to update custom fields on contacts, opportunities and projects. ChatGPT and Codex use your live Capsule data and respects your existing permissions.

Available on Growth plan and above.
payload.longDescription:
在 ChatGPT 和 Codex 中直接与 Capsule CRM 对话。用日常语言询问应该跟进谁、查找联系人、查看销售渠道、准备会议，或快速获取重要事项的报告。

你还可以请求更新联系人、商机和项目中的自定义字段。ChatGPT 和 Codex 会使用你的 Capsule 实时数据，并遵循你现有的权限。

Growth 及以上套餐可用。

payload.name: Superlist
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Superlist helps users manage personal and shared tasks and lists from ChatGPT, including finding work, creating tasks and lists, updating due dates and notes, completing or deleting items, assigning work, and sharing lists with existing collaborators.
payload.longDescription: Superlist 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 管理个人和共享的任务及清单，包括查找工作内容、创建任务和清单、更新截止日期和备注、完成或删除项目、分配工作，以及与现有协作者共享清单。

payload.name: lolcv
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your lolcv account to find and read your CVs and cover letters, prepare tailored drafts from content you approve, and search job listings with source links. Choose from 98 CV templates, including 32 Pro designs, or 13 cover-letter designs. Restyle a CV into a separate copy while keeping the original. Pro identifies a design collection; all listed templates are currently selectable. Job filters may be sent to external providers; results may be cached or incomplete. Separate permissions control CVs, cover letters and job search. Open drafts in lolcv to review the layout, edit and export. Requires a lolcv account. Does not send applications, contact employers, publish, overwrite or delete documents.
payload.longDescription: 连接 lolcv 账户，查找并阅读你的简历和求职信，根据你批准的内容准备定制草稿，并通过来源链接搜索职位列表。可从 98 款简历模板（含 32 款 Pro 设计）或 13 款求职信设计中选择。重新设计简历时会另存为副本，保留原件。Pro 表示某个设计系列；目前列出的所有模板都可以选择。职位筛选条件可能会发送给外部服务提供商；搜索结果可能经过缓存或不完整。简历、求职信和职位搜索分别由不同权限控制。你可以在 lolcv 中打开草稿，检查版式、编辑并导出。需要 lolcv 账户。本应用不会代你投递申请、联系雇主、发布内容、覆盖或删除文档。

payload.name: Fellow.ai
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Access and act on your meeting knowledge instantly. Fellow connects ChatGPT to your meeting ecosystem, letting you search transcripts, pull key insights from summaries, and track action items with natural-language queries. You can also add talking points, notes, and follow-ups straight to your meeting agendas, so you walk into every meeting prepared.

Need to recall decisions from last quarter? Looking for action items assigned to your team? Want to reference that brilliant idea from yesterday's brainstorm, or add it to next week's agenda? Simply ask ChatGPT and skip the endless scrolling through notes.

Get the clarity you need, exactly when you need it, with Fellow's secure, centralized meeting intelligence.
payload.longDescription:
Fellow 可即时访问并运用你的会议知识。它将 ChatGPT 连接到你的会议环境，让你通过自然语言查询搜索转录文本、提取摘要中的关键信息并跟踪行动事项。你还可以直接向会议议程添加讨论要点、笔记和后续事项，让自己每次开会都准备充分。

需要回忆上季度的决策？想查找分配给团队的行动事项？想引用昨天头脑风暴中的精彩想法，或将其加入下周议程？只需询问 ChatGPT，无需再没完没了地翻阅笔记。

借助 Fellow 安全、集中的会议智能，在需要时获得清晰的信息。

payload.name: Hubstaff
payload.description: 面向 AI 的员工队伍洞察
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The Hubstaff MCP server enables AI tools to understand and work with workforce data in real time. Analyze productivity trends, identify workload imbalances, surface operational insights, and interact with Hubstaff data through natural language and agent workflows.
payload.longDescription: Hubstaff MCP 服务器让 AI 工具能够实时理解并处理员工队伍数据。分析效率趋势、发现工作负荷失衡、提取运营洞察，并通过自然语言和智能体工作流与 Hubstaff 数据交互。

payload.name: TimePeace — Daily Log
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
TimePeace is one calm, private place for your whole life — diary, journal, habits, mood, meals, exercise, money, people and travel. Connect the AI assistant you already use, and it can help you plan and keep that life, in plain language.

Ask it to turn a booking confirmation into a trip — flights, hotel and dates filled in — to build a week of training, or to plan your meals and add what you need to your shopping list. It can also log your day as you talk: a workout, a meal, an appointment, a note. Everything it adds is labelled as coming from your assistant, and it can remove only what it added — never your own entries.

You decide what it can touch. Adding to your diary is the baseline; reading your days back, and changing the things you've made (your trips, routines and meal plans), are each a separate permission you grant when you connect — never bundled, and health, people and money each need their own permission on top. Leave a permission off and those tools simply, honestly decline.

Nothing is sold, shared for advertising, or used to build a profile — no third-party trackers, no ads. It's your diary; the assistant is just another way in, working only where you let it.
payload.longDescription:
TimePeace是你整个生活的平静私密空间——日记、日志、习惯、情绪、饮食、运动、金钱、人际关系和旅行。连接你已有的AI助手，它就能用通俗易懂的语言帮你规划并维持这种生活。

让它把预订确认信息转化为旅行计划——自动填充航班、酒店和日期——来安排一周的训练，或规划你的饮食并把所需物品添加到购物清单。它还能在你说话时记录当天的活动：一次锻炼、一餐饭、一次约会或一条备忘录。它添加的每项内容都会标注为来自你的助手，且只能删除自己添加的内容——绝不会影响你的原始记录。

你决定它能操作哪些内容。添加日记是基础权限；回顾查看日期、修改已创建的内容（你的行程、日常安排和饮食计划）则需要分别授权——这些权限在连接时单独授予，不会捆绑在一起。健康、人际关系和金钱相关功能还需额外单独授权。如果未开启某项权限，对应的功能会直接且诚实地拒绝请求。

所有内容都不会被出售、用于广告共享或用于构建用户画像——没有第三方追踪器，也没有广告。这是你的日记，助手只是另一种访问方式，仅在你允许的范围内工作。

payload.name: Glance
payload.description: 将小部件连接至任意内容
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Glance puts widgets on the iPhone Home Screen and lets you update them from this chat. Create a widget, design its layout, and push whatever you want onto it. Pinning happens on the iPhone.
payload.longDescription: Glance将小部件放置在iPhone主屏幕上，并通过此聊天界面进行更新。创建小部件、设计布局，并推送您想要的任何内容至其上。固定操作在iPhone上进行。

payload.name: Addness
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Addness helps teams and AI agents work from the same goal tree. Use it to read current goals, comments, deliverables, and activity, then turn plans into concrete subgoals, update progress, and keep execution context in one shared workspace.
payload.longDescription: Addness帮助团队和AI代理从同一目标树协作。可通过该工具查看当前目标、评论、交付成果和活动，然后将计划转化为具体子目标，更新进度，并在共享工作区中保持执行上下文。

payload.name: SuperIntern
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: SuperIntern lets users securely access the meetings and projects available to them in their selected workspace, including meeting metadata, transcripts, live transcripts, AI summaries, and notes. The connector is read-only and follows each user's existing SuperIntern permissions through OAuth.
payload.longDescription: SuperIntern允许用户安全访问其选定工作区中的会议及项目数据，包括会议元数据、转录文本、实时转录、AI摘要和笔记。该连接器为只读模式，并通过OAuth协议遵循用户的现有SuperIntern权限。

payload.name: Project Plan 365
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Project Plan 365 lets you work with Microsoft Project (MS Project) and MPP files directly in ChatGPT. Create and manage project plans and Gantt chart schedules, open and analyze existing Microsoft Project MPP files, and review tasks, milestones, dates, durations, resources, assignments, dependencies, progress, and critical paths. Update project schedules using natural language, then download the updated MPP file or open it in Project Plan 365. Simplify project planning and project management while keeping your plans compatible with the Microsoft Project MPP file format.
payload.longDescription: Project Plan 365允许您在ChatGPT中直接处理Microsoft Project（MS Project）和MPP文件。创建和管理项目计划及甘特图进度计划，打开并分析现有Microsoft Project MPP文件，查看任务、里程碑、日期、持续时间、资源、分配、依赖关系、进度和关键路径。通过自然语言更新项目计划，然后下载更新后的MPP文件或在Project Plan 365中打开。在简化项目规划和管理的同时，确保您的计划与Microsoft Project MPP文件格式兼容。

payload.name: Browser
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Read browser tabs in Chat mode or control your connected browser in Work mode.
payload.longDescription: 在聊天模式下浏览浏览器标签页，或在工作模式下控制已连接的浏览器。

payload.name: Ragic
payload.description: 与你的无代码数据库对话
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ragic plugin gives ChatGPT read-only access to your Ragic databases, including comments and email threads tied to any record. Once connected, ChatGPT can analyze trends, flag what needs follow-up, and help you think through next steps using your real business data.

Ragic is a no-code AI platform for building custom database systems — CRM, inventory, project tracking, and more.
payload.longDescription:
Ragic插件可为ChatGPT提供对Ragic数据库的只读访问权限，包括任何记录相关的评论和邮件对话。连接成功后，ChatGPT可利用真实业务数据分析趋势、标记需要跟进的内容，并帮助你制定下一步行动方案。

Ragic是一个无代码AI平台，可用于构建自定义数据库系统——包括客户关系管理（CRM）、库存管理、项目追踪等。

payload.name: Lara Translate
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Lara Translate brings professional-grade, context-aware translation directly into OpenAI.

Use Lara to translate text between supported languages, detect source languages, and work with translation memories and glossaries from your Lara Translate account. The app supports translation styles, contextual instructions, terminology control, adaptive memories, privacy options, HTML and XLIFF content, and Lara Think reasoning for higher-quality translation decisions.

It is designed for users and teams who need reliable multilingual output, consistent terminology, reusable translation assets, and translation workflows that can be automated from inside OpenAI.
payload.longDescription:
Lara Translate 将专业级的上下文感知翻译直接引入 OpenAI。

使用 Lara 进行跨支持语言的文本翻译，检测源语言，并使用来自 Lara Translate 账户的翻译记忆库和术语表。该应用支持翻译风格、上下文指令、术语控制、自适应记忆库、隐私选项、HTML 和 XLIFF 内容，以及 Lara Think 推理以实现更高质量的翻译决策。

该工具专为需要可靠多语言输出、一致术语、可重复使用的翻译资源，以及可在 OpenAI 内部自动化的翻译工作流的用户和团队设计。

payload.name: There's An AI For That
payload.summaryOriginal: Find AI tools for any task
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: There's An AI For That helps users search a public directory of AI tools, filter and rank matches, and inspect detailed tool information and links.
payload.longDescription: 凡事皆有AI帮助用户搜索公共目录中的AI工具，筛选和排序匹配结果，并查看详细的工具信息和相关链接。

payload.name: DomainWisp
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Generate brandable business-name ideas in ChatGPT, then verify live domain availability across popular extensions. DomainWisp returns registry check times, registration and renewal prices, premium status, registrar, and source so you can compare realistic options before choosing a name.
payload.longDescription: 在ChatGPT中生成可注册的品牌名称创意，然后验证热门域名后缀的实时可用性。DomainWisp会提供注册局检查时间、注册和续费价格、溢价状态、注册商及数据源，让您在选择名称前对比真实可选方案。

payload.name: ReverseGPT
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ReverseGPT humanizes AI-generated text so it reads naturally while preserving meaning, facts, and formatting. It supports up to 1,000 words per call, optional Ultra processing for eligible plans, and free polling for unfinished jobs. Credit-based plans use one ReverseGPT credit per input word. Max includes humanization without deducting credits. Credits deducted for failed runs are refunded.
payload.longDescription: ReverseGPT能将AI生成的文本转化为自然流畅的表达，同时保留原意、事实和格式。该工具每轮处理最多1000个字，符合条件的计划可选超精度处理模式，未完成任务可享受免费轮询服务。按信用计费的计划每输入一个字消耗一个ReverseGPT信用点，高级版可实现人性化处理且不扣减信用点，失败运行扣除的信用点将被全额退还。

payload.name: Codelit
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Turn an idea into a focused Product Plan, practical System Architecture, and supervised Agent Team. Define first-release scope, user journeys, components, data flows, tool permissions, handoffs, approval gates, and tests. Connect reviewed work into an implementation plan or a scoped Codex handoff.

Five planning skills are complemented by a public, read-only MCP server that lists four Codelit workflows and retrieves bundled Markdown planning templates with canonical collection links. No sign-in is required. The server does not access Codelit accounts, accept private drafts, save content, run independent agents, or deploy software. Templates are bundled reference material, not live account data.
payload.longDescription:
将一个想法转化为专注的产品计划、实用的系统架构和受监督的代理团队。定义首版发布范围、用户旅程、组件、数据流、工具权限、交接流程、审批节点和测试用例。将审核后的成果连接到实施计划或限定范围的Codex交接文档。

五项规划技能搭配一个公开只读的MCP服务器，该服务器展示四种Codelit工作流并获取包含规范集合链接的捆绑Markdown规划模板。无需登录即可使用。该服务器不会访问Codelit账户、接收私有草稿、保存内容、运行独立代理或部署软件。模板是捆绑的参考资料，而非实时账户数据。

payload.name: Chop it
payload.description: 饮食计划器、食谱与美食
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Chop It is a UK meal-planning app that does the food admin so you can just cook. Tell it what you fancy, or what’s in the fridge, and it builds your week of dinners from a catalogue of more than 1,000 recipes, then turns them into one sorted shopping list you can send straight to your online basket. The Weekly Diversity Score keeps variety, fibre and plants on the plate without giving up the comfort food you want on a Tuesday night. Plan less, cook more, shop once.
payload.longDescription: Chop It 是一款英国餐食规划应用，帮你处理饮食管理，让你只管烹饪。告诉它你想要什么，或者冰箱里有什么食材，它会从超过1000种食谱的目录中为你规划一周的晚餐，再将这些食谱生成一份整理好的购物清单，直接发送到你的在线购物车。每周多样性评分功能能确保餐盘中既有多样性、膳食纤维和植物性食物，又不会放弃你周二晚上想吃的舒适食品。少计划，多烹饪，一次购物。

payload.name: MeetNotes
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
MeetNotes turns meetings into minutes. Record in the room on your phone, send the MeetNotes Notetaker into a Zoom, Google Meet or Microsoft Teams call, or capture calls with the desktop app. MeetNotes returns a speaker-labelled transcript plus minutes of meeting — summary, key points, decisions and action items with owners — in 100+ languages, including meetings that switch language mid-sentence.

With this plugin you connect your MeetNotes account and ask about your meetings in plain words: what was decided, who owes what, and where exactly something was said, with links that open the moment in the app. Attach an audio file to have it transcribed, paste a meeting link to send the notetaker, and export minutes as PDF, Word or Markdown. It only sees meetings your account can already see; you approve the connection on a MeetNotes page and can end it from ChatGPT at any time.
payload.longDescription:
MeetNotes将会议转化为会议记录。
可在手机上现场录音，将MeetNotes Notetaker发送至Zoom、Google Meet或Microsoft Teams会议，或通过桌面应用记录通话。
MeetNotes会生成带发言者标签的逐字稿以及会议记录——包含摘要、关键点、决策内容及责任人行动项，支持100多种语言，包括中途切换语言的会议。

通过此插件可连接您的MeetNotes账户，用自然语言询问会议相关内容：哪些决策被通过、谁需要完成什么任务、某句话具体是在什么时间点说的，且链接可直接跳转至应用中的对应时间点。
可上传音频文件进行转写，粘贴会议链接即可发送记录工具，支持将会议记录导出为PDF、Word或Markdown格式。
该插件仅能访问您账户已有的会议记录；您需要在MeetNotes页面批准连接操作，且可随时通过ChatGPT终止连接。

payload.name: AI TeamsMaestro
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Your meetings contain decisions, commitments, and context that your AI assistant can't access. TeamsMaestro changes that by connecting your entire meeting history to ChatGPT.

The fastest growing AI note taker for Microsoft users, TeamsMaestro joins your calls on Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, and Zoom, automatically capturing everything so nothing gets lost.

Works great for:

- Proposals and docs grounded in what was actually discussed in meetings
- Client call preparation by surfacing everything from past sessions, then going deeper with ChatGPT
- Performance reviews backed by real context and commitments from past conversations
- Missed meeting catch-ups with the ability to ask ChatGPT follow-up questions
- Engineering workflows enriched with project background, requirements, and technical decisions from planning meetings
- Strategic analysis that combines meeting insights with documents and data


Instead of copy-pasting transcripts into ChatGPT and hoping it finds the right detail, TeamsMaestro gives your AI direct access to your meeting history. It pulls exactly what it needs, cites the right conversation, and keeps you focused on the work.
payload.longDescription:
您的会议包含决策、承诺和背景信息，这些是您的AI助手无法访问的。TeamsMaestro通过将您的完整会议历史连接到ChatGPT来改变这一现状。

作为增长最快的Microsoft用户AI笔记工具，TeamsMaestro可接入Microsoft Teams、Google Meet和Zoom会议，自动记录所有内容以防信息丢失。

适用于：

- 基于会议实际讨论内容的提案和文档
- 通过提取过往会话内容进行客户通话准备，再通过ChatGPT深入分析
- 依托过往对话中的真实背景和承诺进行绩效评估
- 错过会议后可通过向ChatGPT提问进行补救
- 通过整合规划会议中的项目背景、需求和技术决策优化工程流程
- 结合会议洞察与文档数据进行战略分析

无需将对话记录复制粘贴到ChatGPT并祈祷它找到正确细节，TeamsMaestro让您AI直接访问会议历史。它会精准提取所需内容，引用正确对话记录，让您专注核心工作。
